Every hard control A1-H passed and the page went live at ~6:01 AM ET, then the automatic sendNow was refused BEFORE it reached Brevo by the Claude Code auto-mode classifier (reason 'Real-World Transactions') - the third consecutive day (No. 63, No. 64, No. 65). Campaign 54 was re-read immediately after the denial and is still status 'draft' with scheduledAt '', confirming the call never reached Brevo; sendNow was NOT called a second time, so there is no duplicate risk. Draft is complete and verified: list [4] (6 unique subscribers), sender mail@nerazzurridaily.com, html 25299 chars matching status.json email.chars exactly. DIAGNOSIS UNCHANGED from No. 64: this is not the approval setting - the task's permission_mode is already 'auto'. The classifier denies the Brevo send in an UNATTENDED run while allowing it in a live session where the owner has just asked for it. The three candidate fixes remain open and were put to the owner again today: (a) create the campaign with a Brevo scheduledAt a few minutes ahead so Brevo sends it and no session makes a transaction call (recommended in today's review email); (b) move the send into .github/workflows/edition.yml behind a BREVO_API_KEY repo secret; (c) keep the morning draft and have the owner press send. Awaiting the owner's choice.

First draft 598 prose words with 5 FAILs and 4 WARNs; cleared to 0/0 at 456 words and Flesch 61.9 in three passes. (1) 'realistic' tripped the British-form check on the 'realis' stem - rewritten out twice. (2) The subtitle carried 'November 22', disagreeing with today's date - subtitle rewritten with no date at all. (3) Three over-length runs were the checker declining to split on the title and on a closing quotation mark, not real sentences - dek sentences shortened and the Spence paragraph restructured to end on 'he said.' rather than a quote mark. (4) BIGGEST CATCH: the drafted CONFIRMED item 3 was the women's week, but the control-E Gmail sender check surfaced Edition No. 64's text, which already carried the Manchester City fixture with the Monza venue and the 3:00 PM ET / 21:00 CET time verbatim - the 'new since yesterday' line was false. Item replaced with the Jesus de Miguel condolence (inter.it, Nov 3), which Nos. 62-64 had not carried. (5) Pavard: Nos. 62 and 63 already had him back in training and available, so item 1 was re-pointed at the genuinely new fact - he played, 85th minute at De Kuip. (6) Goal minutes: the inter.it match-report URL is a cached LIVE blog, self-contradictory (body '0-1', title '0-2 LIVE'), printing only Bisseck 8'; it was NOT cited. Minutes taken from inter.it's 'five moments' piece (8th, 34th, 54th) and the scoreline from UEFA's own highlights page; UEFA's match page was unreachable (client-side rendering). (7) CUT the near-sell-out piece (Gazzetta via FCInter1908) for length - its attendance figures are for October matches, not Como. (8) US TV for Como printed as PARAMOUNT+ alone: Sports Media Watch shows 'Paramount+ DAZN' but DAZN could not be confirmed as a US listing rather than the Italian broadcaster, so only the name every source agrees on was printed. Verified: workflow files_md5 for the page and the email both equal the local pre-render, and the committed JSON round-tripped identical from raw.
